_note: Meditate (Pray tab): things Jesus said, each read by a pastor in one of his sermons. src = the recording, a/b = seconds from its start (each clip checked word by word: His first word to His last), t = the words as he reads them. Chosen Nov 2026. Lt = the file's true length (frame by frame; some headers understate it), so the app can put a/b (true times) on the phone's own scale.

sayings.name: Come to Me
sayings.t: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

sayings.name: Your Father Who Sees in Secret
sayings.t: When you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret. And your Father who sees in secret will reward you.

sayings.name: Peace I Leave with You
sayings.t: Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

sayings.name: I Am the Vine
sayings.t: I am the vine; you are the branches. Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

sayings.name: Let Not Your Hearts Be Troubled
sayings.t: Do not let your hearts be troubled. Trust in God; trust also in me. In my Father's house are many rooms; if it were not so, I would have told you. I am going there to prepare a place for you. And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.

sayings.name: I Have Overcome the World
sayings.t: I have said these things to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world.

sayings.name: The Way, the Truth, the Life
sayings.t: I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

sayings.name: The Resurrection and the Life
sayings.t: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live, and everyone who lives and believes in me shall never die. Do you believe this?

sayings.name: The Good Shepherd
sayings.t: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life and have it abundantly. I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

sayings.name: Not My Will, but Yours
sayings.t: Father, if it is Your will, take this cup away from Me; nevertheless not My will, but Yours, be done.

sayings.name: Abide in My Love
sayings.t: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Abide in my love. If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, just as I have kept my Father's commandments and abide in his love. These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full.

sayings.name: I Stand at the Door and Knock
sayings.t: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.

sayings.name: The Light of the World
sayings.t: I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life.

sayings.name: The Bread of Life
sayings.t: I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never thirst.

sayings.name: I Will Never Cast Out
sayings.t: All that the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never cast out.

sayings.name: I Will Not Leave You Orphans
sayings.t: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

sayings.name: Seek First the Kingdom
sayings.t: But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.

sayings.name: Greater Love Has No One
sayings.t: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

sayings.name: If Anyone Thirsts
sayings.t: If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink. Whoever believes in me, as the Scripture has said, 'Out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.'

sayings.name: I Am with You Always
sayings.t: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me. Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the very end of the age.

sayings.name: Lose Your Life to Find It
sayings.t: If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it. For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?

sayings.name: My Sheep Hear My Voice
sayings.t: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me. And I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; neither shall anyone snatch them out of My Father's hand.

sayings.name: Blessed Who Have Not Seen
sayings.t: Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.

sayings.name: The Truth Will Set You Free
sayings.t: If you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

sayings.name: This Is Eternal Life
sayings.t: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

sayings.name: The Pure in Heart
sayings.t: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

sayings.name: Ask, Seek, Knock
sayings.t: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks the door will be opened.

sayings.name: Love the Lord Your God
sayings.t: You will love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind. This is the first and the greatest commandment. And the second is like it: You will love your neighbor as yourself.

sayings.name: Living Water
sayings.t: Whoever drinks of this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst. But the water that I shall give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life.

sayings.name: From Death to Life
sayings.t: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life.

sayings.name: Whoever Loves Me
sayings.t: Whoever has my commandments and keeps them, he it is who loves me. And he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and manifest myself to him.

sayings.name: Not One Sparrow
sayings.t: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father. And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

sayings.name: To Serve and to Give His Life
sayings.t: The Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many.

sayings.name: You Did Not Choose Me
sayings.t: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit and that your fruit should abide, so that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

sayings.name: To Seek and to Save the Lost
sayings.t: For the Son of Man has come to seek and to save that which was lost.

sayings.name: Blessed Are the Poor in Spirit
sayings.t: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth. Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

sayings.name: Let Your Light Shine
sayings.t: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden. Nor do they light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on a lampstand, and it gives light to all who are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

sayings.name: The Harvest Is Plentiful
sayings.t: The harvest truly is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.

sayings.name: For God So Loved
sayings.t: For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life. For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through Him.

sayings.name: Father, Forgive Them
sayings.t: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do.

sayings.name: It Is Finished
sayings.t: It is finished.

sayings.name: Why Have You Forsaken Me?
sayings.t: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?

sayings.name: Not My Will
sayings.t: Abba, Father, all things are possible for You. Take this cup away from Me; nevertheless, not what I will, but what You will.

sayings.name: Into Your Hands
sayings.t: Father, into Your hands I commit My spirit.

sayings.name: Today in Paradise
sayings.t: Truly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in paradise.

sayings.name: The Greatest Commandment
sayings.t: The first of all the commandments is: 'Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one. And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment. And the second, like it, is this: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these.

sayings.name: Abide in Me
sayings.t: Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me.

sayings.name: We Will Make Our Home
sayings.t: If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

sayings.name: Love Your Enemies
sayings.t: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.' But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, so that you may be sons of your Father who is in heaven. For He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.

sayings.name: Love One Another
sayings.t: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.

sayings.name: Take Up Your Cross Daily
sayings.t: If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.

sayings.name: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem
sayings.t: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!

sayings.name: Only Believe
sayings.t: Do not be afraid; only believe.

sayings.name: Take Heart, It Is I
sayings.t: Take heart; it is I. Do not be afraid.

sayings.name: Gain the Whole World
sayings.t: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?

sayings.name: Free Indeed
sayings.t: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

sayings.name: Treasures in Heaven
sayings.t: Do not lay up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal; but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys and where thieves do not break in and steal. For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

sayings.name: Do Not Worry
sayings.t: Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink; nor about your body, what you will put on. Is not life more than food and the body more than clothing? Look at the birds of the air, for they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they? Which of you by worrying can add one cubit to his stature?

sayings.name: Consider the Lilies
sayings.t: Why do you worry about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; and yet I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. Now if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

sayings.name: All Things Are Possible
sayings.t: With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

sayings.name: If You Can Believe
sayings.t: If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.

sayings.name: As I Have Loved You
sayings.t: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

sayings.name: I Have Called You Friends
sayings.t: You are My friends if you do what I command you. No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.

sayings.name: Ask, Seek, Knock
sayings.t: So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

sayings.name: How Much More
sayings.t: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!

sayings.name: Not Everyone Who Says Lord
sayings.t: Not everyone who says to Me, 'Lord, Lord,' shall enter the kingdom of heaven, but he who does the will of My Father in heaven.

sayings.name: Why Call Me Lord?
sayings.t: Why do you call Me 'Lord, Lord,' and you do not do the things which I say?

sayings.name: No One Can Serve Two Masters
sayings.t: No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be loyal to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

sayings.name: Whom to Fear
sayings.t: Do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. But rather fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

sayings.name: Worthy of Me
sayings.t: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me; and anyone who does not take his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me. Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.

sayings.name: Cannot Be My Disciple
sayings.t: Whoever does not bear his own cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.

sayings.name: Hand to the Plow
sayings.t: No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

sayings.name: The Time Is Fulfilled
sayings.t: The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent, and believe in the gospel.

sayings.name: Repent, the Kingdom Is Near
sayings.t: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

sayings.name: Follow Me
sayings.t: Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men.

sayings.name: Not to Be Served
sayings.t: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you, let him be your servant. And whoever desires to be first among you, let him be your slave—just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many.

sayings.name: Wash One Another's Feet
sayings.t: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet. For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.

sayings.name: The Least of These
sayings.t: And the King will answer them, 'Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these My brothers, you did it to Me.'

sayings.name: Come, You Blessed
sayings.t: And the King will say to those on His right hand, 'Come, you blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world: for I was hungry and you gave Me food; I was thirsty and you gave Me drink; I was a stranger and you took Me in; I was naked and you clothed Me; I was sick and you visited Me; I was in prison and you came to Me.'

sayings.name: Well Done, Good and Faithful
sayings.t: Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much. Enter into the joy of your master.

sayings.name: Do This in Remembrance
sayings.t: This is My body, given for you. Do this in remembrance of Me.

sayings.name: My Blood of the Covenant
sayings.t: Drink from it, all of you, for this is My blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

sayings.name: Not as I Will
sayings.t: My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me; nevertheless, not as I will, but as You will.

sayings.name: My Soul Is Sorrowful
sayings.t: My soul is sorrowful, even to the point of death. Remain here and watch with Me.

sayings.name: Watch and Pray
sayings.t: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

sayings.name: I Have Prayed for You
sayings.t: But I have prayed for you, that your faith should not fail; and when you have returned to Me, strengthen your brethren.

sayings.name: Sanctify Them by the Truth
sayings.t: I do not pray that You should take them out of the world, but that You should keep them from the evil one. They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world. Sanctify them by Your truth. Your word is truth.

sayings.name: That They May Be One
sayings.t: My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in Me through their message, that all of them may be one, Father, just as You are in Me and I am in You. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that You have sent Me.

sayings.name: Be with Me Where I Am
sayings.t: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, and to see My glory, the glory You have given Me because You loved Me before the creation of the world.

sayings.name: Revealed to Little Children
sayings.t: I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and have revealed them to babes. Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight. All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows the Son except the Father. Nor does anyone know the Father except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him.

sayings.name: Another Helper
sayings.t: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, to be with you forever, even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. You know Him, for He dwells with you and will be in you.

sayings.name: He Will Teach You All Things
sayings.t: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you.

sayings.name: It Is to Your Advantage
sayings.t: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart. Nevertheless, I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you. But if I go, I will send Him to you.

sayings.name: Into All Truth
sayings.t: However, when the Spirit of truth has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.

sayings.name: That Your Joy May Be Full
sayings.t: Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.

sayings.name: Ask Whatever You Wish
sayings.t: If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you. By this My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit and so prove to be My disciples.

sayings.name: Unless the Father Draws Him
sayings.t: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.

sayings.name: I Will Raise Him Up
sayings.t: For this is the will of My Father, that everyone who looks on the Son and believes in Him should have eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.

sayings.name: I Am the Bread of Life
sayings.t: Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes has eternal life. I am the bread of life.

sayings.name: The Living Bread
sayings.t: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And the bread that I will give for the life of the world is My flesh.

sayings.name: Spirit and Life
sayings.t: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.

sayings.name: Food That Endures
sayings.t: Do not labor for the food which perishes, but for the food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of Man will give you, because God the Father has set His seal upon Him.

sayings.name: My Food Is His Will
sayings.t: My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to accomplish His work.

sayings.name: Lift Up Your Eyes
sayings.t: Do you not say, 'There are still four months and then comes the harvest'? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are already white for harvest!

sayings.name: In Spirit and Truth
sayings.t: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for the Father is seeking such to worship Him. God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth.

sayings.name: I Am the Good Shepherd
sayings.t: I am the good shepherd. I know My own and My own know Me, just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.

sayings.name: I Am the Door
sayings.t: I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.

sayings.name: The Light of the World
sayings.t: I must work the works of Him who sent Me while it is day; the night is coming when no one can work. As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

sayings.name: If I Am Lifted Up
sayings.t: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all peoples to Myself.

sayings.name: You Would See the Glory
sayings.t: Did I not say to you that if you would believe you would see the glory of God?

sayings.name: Whoever Has Seen Me
sayings.t: Have I been with you so long, and you still do not know Me, Philip? Whoever has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, 'Show us the Father'?

sayings.name: If the World Hates You
sayings.t: If the world hates you, know that it has hated Me before it hated you. If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

sayings.name: As the Father Has Sent Me
sayings.t: Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, even so I am sending you.

sayings.name: Touch Me and See
sayings.t: Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts? Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have.

sayings.name: Go into All the World
sayings.t: Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.

sayings.name: You Shall Receive Power
sayings.t: But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.

sayings.name: The Spirit of the Lord
sayings.t: The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He has anointed Me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty those who are oppressed, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

sayings.name: I Came to Call Sinners
sayings.t: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.

sayings.name: Joy over One Sinner
sayings.t: Likewise, I say to you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.

sayings.name: The One Lost Sheep
sayings.t: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, does he not leave the ninety-nine and go to the mountains to seek the one that is straying? And if he should find it, assuredly, I say to you, he rejoices more over that sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray. Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

sayings.name: Went Home Justified
sayings.t: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.

sayings.name: The Greatest Shall Serve
sayings.t: But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant. And whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.

sayings.name: Unless You Repent
sayings.t: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

sayings.name: Blessed Are the Persecuted
sayings.t: Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are you when they revile and persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely for My sake. Rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven, for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

sayings.name: Blessed Are the Peacemakers
sayings.t: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.

sayings.name: Blessed Are the Merciful
sayings.t: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall receive mercy.

sayings.name: Salt of the Earth
sayings.t: You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt loses its flavor, how shall it be seasoned? It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by men.

sayings.name: Be Perfect
sayings.t: Be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

sayings.name: If You Forgive Others
sayings.t: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

sayings.name: Judge Not
sayings.t: Judge not, that you be not judged. For with what judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.

sayings.name: The Log in Your Eye
sayings.t: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye? Or how can you say to your brother, 'Let me take the speck out of your eye,' when there is the log in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother's eye.

sayings.name: The Narrow Gate
sayings.t: Enter by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and there are many who go in by it. Because narrow is the gate and difficult is the way which leads to life, and there are few who find it.

sayings.name: Bless Those Who Curse You
sayings.t: But I say to you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, and pray for those who spitefully use you.

sayings.name: Be Merciful
sayings.t: But love your enemies, do good, and lend, hoping for nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High. For He is kind to the unthankful and evil. Therefore be merciful, just as your Father also is merciful.

sayings.name: Give, and It Will Be Given
sayings.t: Judge not, and you shall not be judged. Condemn not, and you shall not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven. Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be put into your bosom. For with the same measure that you use, it will be measured back to you.

sayings.name: Out of the Heart
sayings.t: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.

sayings.name: Sheep Among Wolves
sayings.t: I am sending you out like sheep among wolves. Therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

sayings.name: Confess Me Before Men
sayings.t: Therefore whoever confesses Me before men, him I will also confess before My Father who is in heaven. But whoever denies Me before men, him I will also deny before My Father who is in heaven.

sayings.name: With Me or Against Me
sayings.t: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters abroad.

sayings.name: My Brother and Sister
sayings.t: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.

sayings.name: Why Did You Doubt?
sayings.t: You of little faith, why did you doubt?

sayings.name: I Will Build My Church
sayings.t: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.

sayings.name: Faith as a Mustard Seed
sayings.t: Because of your unbelief; for assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith as a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

sayings.name: Become Like Little Children
sayings.t: I say to you, unless you are converted and become as little children, you will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven. Therefore whoever humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

sayings.name: Where Two or Three Gather
sayings.t: For where two or three come together in My name, there am I with them.

sayings.name: Let the Children Come
sayings.t: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of heaven.

sayings.name: Daughter, Your Faith
sayings.t: Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your affliction.

sayings.name: Your Faith Has Saved You
sayings.t: Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

sayings.name: Names Written in Heaven
sayings.t: Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven.

sayings.name: Martha, Martha
sayings.t: Martha, Martha, you are worried and troubled about many things. But one thing is needed, and Mary has chosen that good part, which will not be taken away from her.

sayings.name: Where Your Treasure Is
sayings.t: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

sayings.name: My Words Will Not Pass Away
sayings.t: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.

sayings.name: Not by Bread Alone
sayings.t: It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.'

sayings.name: Behold, I Am Coming Quickly
sayings.t: Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to give to every one according to his work. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last.

sayings.name: More Blessed to Give
sayings.t: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
